gameDescriptionHtml:
New York City, New Year’s Eve 1999. Four professional cleaners working for the mob gather to drink and reminisce about their careers. As the details of their stories stop matching up, the ugly truth behind their cooperation begins to reveal itself.

Game Features

  • Clean Up The Crime Scenes: Get rid of the bodies, make the place spotless, and don’t get caught.
  • Choose Your Playstyle: Plan every step and move like a ghost or trust your reflexes and thrive in chaos. The choice is yours.
  • Four Characters: Alternate between four characters, each with a unique skill set, opening up new possibilities.
  • Feel The 90s: Serial Cleaners’ setting—inspired by cult ‘90s movies—will bring back fond memories of the more carefree decade full of brightly colored optimism… and the grime underneath it all.
